## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Shèng mán bǎo kū* in 3 fascicles is the great Suí-period commentary by [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) Jízàng on the *[Śrīmālā-siṃha-nāda-sūtra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0045)* (T0353). One of Jízàng's most influential commentaries, it remained the standard authoritative reading of the *Śrīmālā* in East Asian Buddhist scholarship throughout the medieval period and was foundational for the *tathāgatagarbha* doctrinal tradition.

**Abstract**

The work belongs to [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) Jízàng's mature scholarly period at the imperial Suí court (595 – 623 CE).

The Taishō text (T1744) is established on the standard apparatus.
